tips.text:
SHUGO/NIGHTMARE - BUY DAEVA POINTS - Very important especially for hitting 1900/2100 Bracket!
ABYSS POINTS - BUY STIGMA SHARDS
-----------------------------------------------------------------
Manastones is just for the tier of roll, doesn't HAVE to be attack. You can put Superior manastone on ascension bracelet since you will use that for a long time.
Yes PvP feathers for PvP Daevanion.

If you do isle boss and get a 70 piece you already have, giving 2 boss pieces to supply request is 50k+ AP
If you get Vakron Guard , dont need to tap your Pilgrim accessories. This is a GENERAL guide, if you don't get all vakron, but get more aulamus accessories its fine, if you craft gear to replace its fine. 8 Pieces of Yellow 70gs gear is enough to get you to 1900. Can be a mix of both t2 dungeons. If you don't hit your blue arcana cards, you cap tap, just never hit anything above 10 for early game. THEOSTONES GIVES some gearscore. These are more for what color you want your glow, pve doesnt matter what you pick.

Goal is to get to 2000gs and do HARD Ascension trial before end of week (if you can't make it its fine but this is your next goal) You want atleast 4k Score in ascencion trial to unlock 3 Mysterious Crstals from the Season Mission (season>Season Mission > Challenge > Season > Tower of Trials) After this you will spend 25k Season coins in the Season shop for a 4th Mysterious Crytstal) and you will EXTRACT Arcana cards (Arcana>Extract) to make your 5th card! With these 5 Mysterious crystals you will craft a GOLD Arcana CHALICE (MUST BE A CHALICE because chalice ONLY drops from 2500+ Transcendence.

You MIGHT need a little extra juice to get 4k score, You need to beat it in 3:28s roughly. The faster you do it the more score you get.

FOR FIRE TEMPLE, YOU WILL TAKE THE GEAR EXCHANGE TICKET, SHOULD YOU PITY THREE TIMES YOU WILL EQUIPMENT SWAP TO YOUR WEAPON. If you happen to get weapon on the way to third pity, and have a gear exchange coupon with an extra accessory, change to one you need.

FOR HORN DEN YOU WILL ALSO TAKE THREE GEAR EXCHANGE TICKETS, FOR THE GUARD. If you happen to get guard on way to third pity, take armor piece you dont have.

For Ludra Hardmode you need full +16 with +17 weapons, All 120 Ariel from all hardmodes. Offset with more +17s
------------------------------------------------------------------
CHANTER SPECIFIC
My Character - https://shugo.gg/character/global/naw-zikel/Desolo

Dark Crush Lvl 16 > Onslaught Lvl 16 > Spinning Strike Lvl 16

Dark Crush 16 - always critically hit / no dark crush cd
Dark Crush 20 -add piercing strike chain skill

Onslaught 16 - reduce spinning strike by 1 second / storm chain skill
Onslaught 20 - add hp Absorb / OR multi chance for dps

Spinning strike 16 - -5 second cd / ignores evasion and crits
Spinning strike 20 - add do 20% more damage

Build Overview
This build focuses on maximizing personal DPS while supporting the group through buffs, debuffs, and supplemental healing.
Resources:

• KR Chanter Rankers Leaderboard Guide - https://cielui.com/guide/%ED%98%B8%EB%B2%95%EC%84%B1

Equipment
• Prioritize enhancing your gear to +20.

• Reroll substats toward priority skills, Double Chance, Multi-Hit, and Attack. Use Questlog’s equipment rankings to check the preferred substats for each slot.

• Aim for Attack/Defense/Accuracy rolls on Manastones/Soulstones. Two or three good rolls are sufficient for now; avoid spending heavily on perfect rolls.
